6. The check always failed and reset to all gray
7. Making all 9 blocks green doesn't trigger a check or complete the level

- Some other interaction

- Check 1: 4 corners all green → fail (because cross/center should also be green)
- Check 2: 4 cross all green → fail (because corners/center should also be green)
- Check 3: all 9 blocks green → ??? (no check triggered)
Maybe the level completes when all 9 blocks are green, but there's a delay or additional condition. Or maybe the level completes when I click a specific block AFTER all 9 are green.
Let me try clicking the center block when all 9 are green. Earlier, clicking the center block triggered the check when cross blocks were green. Maybe it triggers a different check when all blocks are green.
Actually, I already tried this! In one of my earlier attempts, I clicked the center block when cross blocks were green (and corners were gray), which triggered the check. But I haven't tried clicking the center when ALL blocks are green.
Let me try that.
